tool.name: ampvis2 load
tool.description: Reads an OTU or ASV table and corresponding sample metadata, and returns a RDS data set for use in all ampvis2 tools.
tool.command: Rscript -e 'library(ampvis2); amp_load(input_otu_table, input_metadata, input_taxonomy, input_tree, input_fasta, guess_types=$guess_types, output_list_datasets=$output_list_datasets)'

param.name: input_otu_table
param.label: OTU Table
param.help: Tabular data set or BIOM version (1 and 2)

param.name: input_fasta
param.label: Fasta File
param.help: FASTA file containing the sequences of the OTUs

param.name: guess_types
param.label: Guess metadata column types
param.help: Automatically guess data types for metadata columns

tool.help:
# Ampvis2 Load
This tool reads an OTU or ASV table and corresponding sample metadata, and returns a RDS data set for use in all ampvis2 tools.
## Inputs
- **OTU Table**: Tabular data set or BIOM version (1 and 2). - **Sample Metadata**: Additional information about the samples. - **Taxonomy Table**: Tabular data set with 7 columns. - **Phylogenetic Tree**: Newick format. - **Fasta File**: FASTA file containing the sequences of the OTUs.
## Outputs
- **RDS Data Set**: Main output of the tool. - **Taxonomy List**: Summarizes the taxonomy information. - **Metadata List**: Summarizes the metadata information.
